2026-07-06T13:13:40.7842310Z function wait_for_startup() {
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7842731Z     local pid="$1"
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7843083Z     local server_name="$2"

2026-07-06T13:13:40.7844344Z     local now_s=`date '+%s'`

2026-07-06T13:13:40.7845153Z

2026-07-06T13:13:40.7845507Z

2026-07-06T13:13:40.7849125Z

2026-07-06T13:13:40.7850620Z         if [[ $status -eq 200 || $status -eq 401 ]]; then
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7851077Z             echo "OK"
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7851307Z             echo "Started [pid $pid]"
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7851566Z             return 0
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7851779Z         fi
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7851959Z         sleep 2
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7852158Z         now_s=`date '+%s'`
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7852377Z     done
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7852482Z 
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7852701Z     echo "The operation timed out when attempting to connect to $server_url" >&2

2026-07-06T13:13:40.7853365Z 
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7853460Z function free_memory() {
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7853683Z     local free=""
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7853881Z     local os=`uname`
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7854090Z     if [ "$os" == "Linux" ]; then
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7854460Z         local mem_free=`cat /proc/meminfo | grep -w "MemFree" | awk '{print $2}'`
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7854961Z         local mem_buffer=`cat /proc/meminfo | grep -w "Buffers" | awk '{print $2}'`
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7855459Z         local mem_cached=`cat /proc/meminfo | grep -w "Cached" | awk '{print $2}'`
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7856101Z         if [[ "$mem_free" == "" || "$mem_buffer" == "" || "$mem_cached" == "" ]]; then
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7856594Z             echo "Failed to get free memory"
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7856859Z             exit 1
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7857049Z         fi
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7857288Z         free=`expr $mem_free + $mem_buffer + $mem_cached`
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7857646Z         free=`expr $free / 1024`
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7857897Z     elif [ "$os" == "Darwin" ]; then
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7858340Z         local pages_free=`vm_stat | awk '/Pages free/{print $0}' | awk -F'[:.]+' '{print $2}' | tr -d " "`
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7858997Z         local pages_inactive=`vm_stat | awk '/Pages inactive/{print $0}' | awk -F'[:.]+' '{print $2}' | tr -d " "`
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7859893Z         local pages_available=`expr $pages_free + $pages_inactive`
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7860292Z         free=`expr $pages_available \* 4096 / 1024 / 1024`
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7860593Z     else
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7860807Z         echo "Unsupported operating system $os"
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7861098Z         exit 1
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7861289Z     fi
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7861467Z     echo $free
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7861647Z }
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7861745Z 
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7861830Z function calc_xmx() {
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7862042Z     local min_mem=$1
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7862257Z     local max_mem=$2
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7862477Z     # Get machine available memory
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7862733Z     local free=`free_memory`
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7862969Z     local half_free=$[free/2]
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7863127Z 
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7863208Z     local xmx=$min_mem
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7863434Z     if [[ "$free" -lt "$min_mem" ]]; then
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7863693Z         exit 1
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7863917Z     elif [[ "$half_free" -ge "$max_mem" ]]; then
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7864196Z         xmx=$max_mem
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7864421Z     elif [[ "$half_free" -lt "$min_mem" ]]; then
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7864693Z         xmx=$min_mem
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7864887Z     else
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7865070Z         xmx=$half_free
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7865272Z     fi
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7865445Z     echo $xmx
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7865630Z }

2026-07-06T13:13:40.7872470Z function get_ip() {
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7872676Z     local os=`uname`
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7872890Z     local loopback="127.0.0.1"
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7873130Z     local ip=""
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7873324Z     case $os in
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7873506Z         Linux)

2026-07-06T13:13:40.7876210Z             fi
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7876391Z             ;;
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7876583Z         FreeBSD|OpenBSD|Darwin)

2026-07-06T13:13:40.7877646Z             else
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7877840Z                 ip=$loopback
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7878054Z             fi
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7878241Z             ;;
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7878424Z         SunOS)
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7878633Z             if command_available "ifconfig"; then
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7879021Z                 ip=`ifconfig -a | grep inet | grep -v "$loopback" | awk '{ print $2} '`
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7879681Z             else
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7879892Z                 ip=$loopback
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7880113Z             fi
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7880290Z             ;;
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7880480Z         *) ip=$loopback;;
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7880693Z     esac
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7880866Z     echo $ip
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7881044Z }

2026-07-06T13:13:40.7892029Z function wait_for_shutdown() {
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7892277Z     local process_name="$1"
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7892509Z     local pid="$2"
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7892714Z     local timeout_s="$3"
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7892857Z 
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7892949Z     local now_s=`date '+%s'`
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7893207Z     local stop_s=$(( $now_s + $timeout_s ))
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7893400Z 
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7893523Z     echo -n "Killing $process_name(pid $pid)" >&2
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7893833Z     while [ $now_s -le $stop_s ]; do
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7894081Z         echo -n .
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7894324Z         process_status "$process_name" "$pid" >/dev/null
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7894634Z         if [ $? -eq 1 ]; then
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7894859Z             echo "OK"
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7895062Z             return 0
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7895263Z         fi
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7895447Z         sleep 2
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7895650Z         now_s=`date '+%s'`
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7895866Z     done
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7896156Z     echo "$process_name shutdown timeout(exceeded $timeout_s seconds)" >&2
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7896520Z     return 1
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7896698Z }
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7896796Z

2026-07-06T13:13:40.7898024Z         echo "$process_name is running with pid $pid"
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7898312Z         return 0
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7898498Z     else
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7898720Z         echo "The process $process_name does not exist"
2026-07-06T13:13:40.7899014Z         return 1

2026-07-06T13:13:40.7899627Z }

2026-07-06T13:13:50.8817814Z # wait_for_startup friendly_name host port timeout_s
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8818399Z function wait_for_startup() {
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8818828Z     local pid="$1"
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8819215Z     local server_name="$2"
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8819929Z     local server_url="$3"
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8820343Z     local timeout_s="$4"
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8820608Z 
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8820769Z     local now_s=`date '+%s'`
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8821210Z     local stop_s=$(( $now_s + $timeout_s ))
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8821551Z 
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8821696Z     local status
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8821911Z 
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8822140Z     echo -n "Connecting to $server_name ($server_url)"
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8822699Z     while [ $now_s -le $stop_s ]; do
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8823144Z         echo -n .
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8823589Z         process_status "$server_name" "$pid" >/dev/null
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8824142Z         if [ $? -eq 1 ]; then
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8824614Z             echo "Starting $server_name failed"
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8825132Z             return 1
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8825487Z         fi
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8825663Z 
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8825998Z         status=`curl -o /dev/null -s -k -w %{http_code} $server_url`
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8826666Z         if [[ $status -eq 200 || $status -eq 401 ]]; then
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8827178Z             echo "OK"
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8827564Z             echo "Started [pid $pid]"
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8828018Z             return 0
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8828363Z         fi
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8828671Z         sleep 2
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8829013Z         now_s=`date '+%s'`
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8829604Z     done
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8829795Z 
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8830174Z     echo "The operation timed out when attempting to connect to $server_url" >&2
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8830868Z     return 1
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8831182Z }

2026-07-06T13:13:50.8832246Z     local os=`uname`

2026-07-06T13:13:50.8902053Z function wait_for_shutdown() {

2026-07-06T13:13:50.8902639Z     local pid="$2"
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8902847Z     local timeout_s="$3"

2026-07-06T13:13:50.8903082Z     local now_s=`date '+%s'`

2026-07-06T13:13:50.8903525Z 
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8903654Z     echo -n "Killing $process_name(pid $pid)" >&2
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8903960Z     while [ $now_s -le $stop_s ]; do

2026-07-06T13:13:50.8905178Z             return 0
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8905373Z         fi
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8905646Z         sleep 2

2026-07-06T13:13:50.8906186Z     done
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8906572Z     echo "$process_name shutdown timeout(exceeded $timeout_s seconds)" >&2
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8907218Z     return 1
2026-07-06T13:13:50.8907534Z }
